data: According to its fiscal 2024 Form 10-K, Tesla reported diluted earnings per share of $2.04 for fiscal 2024, down from $4.30 in fiscal 2023. That is a decline of $2.26 per share, or about 52.6%. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $7,153 million, of which $7,091 million was attributable to common stockholders. That compares with $14,974 million and $14,997 million respectively in fiscal 2023. Much of the year-over-year drop reflects a one-time item in fiscal 2023: a $5,001 million income tax benefit, driven largely by the release of a deferred tax asset valuation allowance. Fiscal 2024 instead had a $1,837 million tax provision. Income from operations also fell, from $8,891 million to $7,076 million.
